chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Hishām ibn Sālim, from Mālik ibn Aʿyan, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: concerning

Regarding a female slave jointly owned by two men: one of them emancipated his share, and when his partner heard that, he rushed upon the slave-girl and deflowered her that very day. He عليه السلام said: “The one who deflowered her is to be struck with fifty lashes, and fifty lashes are waived from him on account of his right in her, and he is to pay the slave-girl one-tenth of her value for having had intercourse with her, and she is to be made to work to pay off the remainder.”

key_terms.تُسْتَسْعَى: she is required to work to pay off the remaining amount
key_terms.خَمْسِينَ جَلْدَةً: fifty lashes as the prescribed punishment portion
key_terms.عُشْرَ قِيمَتِهَا: one-tenth of her value as compensation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one co-owner frees his share of a slave-girl and the other co-owner then has intercourse with her?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a jointly owned female slave when one partner frees his share and the other then has intercourse with her. It sets out a reduced hadd-style punishment due to partial ownership, financial compensation owed to the slave-girl, and the ruling concerning the remaining share.
